column1: # Altin Peak: the mine has collapsed with men pinned behind the rubble.

column3: The roof came down and men\nare pinned behind that\nrubble while the water{page_break}rises.{page_break}Will you help dig them out?{end_now}
Thank the Wise One! Hurry,\nbefore the water wins.{end_wait}
Then go on, if you must.\nMay the mountain forgive\nyou.{end_wait}
Dig for strangers? The\nmountain took them, so let\nit keep them.{end_wait}
Mia! Men are dying under\nthere! Do you hear\nyourself?{end_wait}
I hear a fool who forgets\nAlex is ahead of us. Go on,\nbe slow.{end_wait}
We dig, all of us. Nobody\nstays behind.{end_wait}
They're breathing, and you\nsaved them. Take this\nbread, it's all we have.{end_wait}
The water's going down. You\nhave my thanks.{end_wait}
